title: Intel Corporation to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference
summary: Intel executives will participate in a fireside chat at the Deutsche Bank Conference.
body_markdown:
**SANTA CLARA, Calif., August 18, 2026 –** Intel Corporation today announced that David Zinsner, executive vice president and chief financial officer, and John Pitzer, corporate vice president, global treasury and investor relations, will participate in a fireside chat on Intel’s business and strategy at the Deutsche Bank's 2026 Technology Conference on August 26 at 10:35 a.m. PDT


A live webcast and replay can be accessed publicly on Intel's Investor Relations website at[intc.com](https://www.intc.com/) .


Intel’s participation, speakers and schedule are subject to change.


## About Intel


Intel (Nasdaq: INTC) designs and manufactures advanced semiconductors that connect and power the modern world. Every day, our engineers create new technologies that enhance and shape the future of computing to enable new possibilities for every customer we serve. Learn more at[intel.com](https://www.intel.com/) .
